description: The full data contract of one dataset (kind='topic') or lookup table (kind='dimension'): the machine-readable document, in the Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) v3.2 format, that defines its columns, keys, units, quality checks, source, and limitations. fmt='yaml' (default) returns the document as published; fmt='json' returns it parsed. It is long (often 10 to 50 KB); describe_dataset gives the same schema in a smaller, query-ready form.

main_topic.description: Subject area: 'education' (the default), 'census', or 'immigration'. A dataset's key starts with it.
main_topic.title: Main Topic

name.description: Dataset name (e.g. 'act_scores', or its full key 'education/gosa/act_scores') or lookup table name.
name.title: Name

name: get_contract
title: Get a Dataset's Data Contract
